description.zh: 房主按 Y 打开物品面板：分类、名称搜索、翻页，左键领取 1 个，按住 Shift 点击领取多个（默认 10，可在设置里改）；可一次性恢复体温和血量。可叠在背包或设备界面上，Esc 返回原页。按键可在游戏设置中修改。
description.en: Press Y as host to browse, search and give items: click for 1, Shift-click for more (10 by default, adjustable in settings). Includes restore warmth and health actions. Opens over inventory or device pages; Esc returns to the previous page. Rebind in the game's controls settings.
